QuestInfo.name: [Azwan] Rumors of Azwan
QuestInfo.0: Listen to the details of the Alliance mission from #bNeinheart#k in #bEreve#k.
QuestInfo.1:
According to Neinheart, traces of the #bancient city Azwan#k were recently discovered near Ariant. #rCommander Hilla#k is apparently from Azwan, so if you go there, you may learn more about her.

Since the knights have already been dispatched there, you need to go to #bAzwan Obelisk#k and collect information on Hilla with them.
QuestInfo.2: It seems news of Azwan has already spread. There is a rumor of an Elixir of Everlasting Youth in Azwan.

0.0: Pardon the long preamble, but I have more context to give. Traces of the #bancient city of Azwan#k were recently discovered near Ariant.
0.1: #rHilla#k, one of the Commanders of the Black Mage, supposedly hails from Azwan. In order to join the Black Mage, Hilla offered him the city of Azwan, which resulted in its supposed destruction.
0.2: As much as that speaks to her character as a shamaness of darkness and a follower of the Black Mage, what interests the Alliance is further information about her that may remain in Azwan.
0.3: The knights have already been dispatched to the area, but progress is slow. You're to join them and aid in the information gathering effort. Prepare to depart immediately.\r\n#b#e(If you accept, you will move to Azwan Obelisk automatically.)#n#k

no.0: Do you still have business in Ereve? Please take care of it and dispatch soon.

1.0: Another traveler? I'll warn you up front, instead of some so-called Elixir of Everlasting Youth, all anyone's found is a festering heap of monsters. Don't let your curiosity get the better of you.

yes.0: ...*gasp* Wait, you're from the Alliance! Ahem, excuse me. There's just been droves of wannabe treasure hunters snooping around and well, just sorry.

npc.0: The knights have already been dispatched to the #bAzwan Obelisk#k, but progress is slow. You're to join them and aid in the information gathering effort.
